target_profile.pixel_style: pure black and white, 1-bit-ready e-paper reference
target_profile.runtime_text: The renderer supplies actual English and zh-CN text from menu_v5_localization. Generated guide strokes may only define text placement.
target_profile.asset_storage: external Flash CEMP only after separate source, renderer, import and physical gates

source_references.role: truthful five-screen family and review order

prompt: Edit the attached compact no-face Companion menu-family candidate. Preserve every screen except Connection: keep the exact white background, black 1-bit line language, five-screen storyboard, no pet face in menus, Home four full-height rows with clear right chevrons, compact detail top bars, and all existing Voice, Device and Preferences row structures. Change only screen 4 Connection: show exactly three generous truthful rows below its compact back/title bar: Pair new device, Link status, Reconnect. Remove the fourth information row completely and redistribute vertical space evenly across the three remaining rows. Pair new device and Reconnect have small right chevrons; Link status has a calm dot/value marker, not a chevron. Do not create any additional Connection item, fake control, fake value, new text, face, decoration, fifth row, grey, gradients, shadows, texture, device frame, cards or blobs. The source remains a layout baseline; English and Chinese labels are renderer-owned.
negative_constraints: any menu header face or expression
review_contract: After generation, split the family into five locked 200x200 original pages; render English and zh-CN overlays for each; attach exact paths and hashes; then show one page per canonical Chinese prompt in the declared order. No contact sheet alone can receive an owner decision. The v7.0 candidate is retained as a rejected header-face reference, v7.1 as a superseded missing-chevron candidate and v7.2 as a superseded Connection-scope candidate; none is a source or fallback.
